title: ProcessItem
description: A kind of the process of the operator: the flow of a project or the shared subagents.

kind.description: flow for the flow of a project, shared for the shared subagents. library is the shared subagents in the process.synced events of earlier versions of Gentry, which called them the library of subagents; Gentry no longer writes it.

project.description: Identifier of the project; only for a flow.
